description: Aléa érosion d’avant-côte des Alpes Maritimes entre 2016 et 2022 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte Inondations, Aménagement et Gestion de l'Eau Maralpin. The dataset provides a characterization of coastal Alpes Maritimes exposure to near-coastal erosion hazard. This information is therefore closely linked to the sediment balance of the underwater zone of the beach system and completes the reading of the coastal vulnerability, when the result is combined with that of the coastal feature erosion hazard: It concerns ... Coverage: Syndicat Mixte Inondations, Aménagement et Gestion de l'Eau Maralpin. The portal shows the English title as "Aléa coastal erosion of the Alpes Maritimes between 2016 and 2022" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Mixte Inondations, Aménagement et Gestion de l'Eau Maralpin. Its keywords include dinamis, monlittoral, erosion-marine, spatial, sentinel-2, erosion-cotiere. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PDF, QML, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
